_readme: Tuning numbers. Change them and reload; no code needed.
solo: energyCost = share of her max energy a solo night costs; clientCap = most clients she'll see that week afterward; lustDrop = how much it lowers her lust.

lovers: neglectWeeks = weeks in a row without Sam before she feels left out (when another lover isn't); missedMood = mood lost each week she's restless and Sam doesn't see her; jealousyChance = weekly odds of that event. Shared scenes are tuned in bonds.json.

breakup: mood / trust = what ending it costs her (Loyal ladies lose half the trust); rekindleTrust = trust she needs before Sam can ask her back; rekindleChance = base odds she says yes (better if she's happy); rekindleCooldown = weeks between attempts.
lust: low = below this she turns down the heavier services; eager = she's in the mood (bonuses below); high = 'restless' (solo nights, reckless nights, lovers come looking for Sam).

lust.build: weekly gain = base + lewdness*perLewd (+eagerTrait for Eager/Exhibitionist, +resting), times her personality's lustBuild and her lustBuild fx (races, traits: data/races.json, data/traits.json).

lust.drop: how much each thing lowers it right away: private = private time with Sam, train = practicing with Sam. Client services now use the per-service 'lust' value in services.json (x technique etc.); client/fav here are the legacy fallback for services without one. Giving services, kisses and massages build lust only with Sam (with clients, only for ladies with the svcLustBuild fx, e.g. Insatiable). Lewder ladies drop less per act (dropAtLewd0 → dropAtLewd100). samRelease: Sam's private time and practice spend drop.private / drop.train x (min + (max-min) x his Technique/100).
lust.profile.floorPerLewd: her lust never falls below lewdness × this (a very lewd lady is never fully sated).
Insatiable / Slow to Warm and the race multipliers are now fx in data/traits.json and data/races.json (lustBuild, lustDrop, lustFloor, lustMax). lust.traitChance = odds a generic lady has the trait.
lust.bonus: extra mood/trust from private time with Sam when she's eager or restless (trainMult scales it for practice sessions); clientMood = mood per client service while eager.

renewal: her willingness = (trust×0.6 + mood×0.4)/100 (+loyal for Loyal ladies). At freeAt or above she re-signs for free; below that the fee scales up toward feeWeeks × her wage; below refuseBelow she's thinking of leaving and may say no. raise = size of the raise option; raiseBoost = how much it helps her willingness.

wages: contracts renew at her current going rate (wageFor, which rises with her skills and popularity). Between renewals she asks for a raise once her wage falls below askAt × her going rate (askAtAmbitious for Ambitious/Greedy).
mood: restingPoint = the mood she drifts back toward each week (drift = how fast); overworkAt = how many clients a week before she feels overworked.
income.escort: multiplier on all escort and off-duty service fees.

ngplus: New Game+ (after paying off the debt). Sam keeps ONLY his home house (rooms, tier, upgrades, beds); other houses are sold for saleValue x their price, paid toward the debt. New debt = home house debt x debtShare x (1 + perCycle for each cycle after the second) + improvementsValue x improveShare (improvementsValue = gold spent on rooms, tiers, quarters, beds, annex and upgrades in the home house, tracked in h.spent). purse = gold Sam keeps in hand; savings above it go straight to the new debt (up to half of it). samKeep = share of Sam's stats he keeps (1 = all). Only Devoted lovers come along (they draw wages again, stats reset: named ones to their data values, generic ones to 50%, popularity 0, trust and lewdness back to where they started: named from data, generic from when they were rolled, else baseTrust/baseLewd) and each picks one NG+ perk (traits.json ngPerk). NG+ houses (economy.json ngplus) and NG+ partners (characters.json ngplus) only appear from cycle 2; NG+ houses are bought during the cycle.Sam also takes a new house each cycle (houseOffers deeds, no premium ones; its debt x newHouseShare x (1 + perCycle for each cycle after the second) joins the new debt; its resident comes along) and may add one more past life (economy.json pasts, each once). reborn: every lady who carries over gains a stack of the Reincarnated perk (w.reborn): trust gain x (1 + trust x stacks), skill gain x (1 + skill x stacks), stat gain x (1 + stat x stacks), lewdness gain x (1 + lewd x stacks).

svc: per-service rules. tech* = the range of a client's technique; frustrateAt = a finishing service leaves her frustrated when technique x (her lust/60) is below this (her lust rises by frustrateLust). encore* = chance (+ her encore fx) and fee share of a reckless lady's second round. race* = enthusiast / put-off clients (data/races.json client). demon: demons don't sleep: each working week costs them hunger energy, and they gain energy per finishing service (feed, or feedReckless when restless, which costs house reputation repDrain unless the house has a Binding Sigil); with Sam she gains samGain and Sam loses samExtra more energy. android: recharge fee (fee + perEnergy x energy restored; the Charging Alcove takes chargerDiscount off). refusalMood = beastkin mood loss when Sam turns down a restless request (a Grooming Den halves it).

jobs: courtesanTh = how many points lower a courtesan's comfort lines sit; propWant = chance a client asks for a service (courtesans vs. everyone else who steps in); promoter draw = promoterBase + (charm+service)/promoterDiv clients, samples multiply it (samplesDraw) and cost samplesEnergy energy and samplesLust lust, rep change = (quality-0.5) x samplesRep; attendant: courtesans spend attendantEnergy x energy and clients are attendantSat happier; a house can have as many attendants as courtesan positions, and each courtesan with her own attendant (most popular first) gets attendantOwnMood mood and attendantOwnTrust trust a week; madame: cuts the house's mood losses to madameMoodLoss, matches clients to a fitting lady (+madameMatchSat sat), and coaches courtesans she out-ranks by madamePopGap popularity: each skill she is better at grows by madameCoach x the difference (rounded down); stepIn* = how many clients a madame/attendant takes when courtesans are swamped and the energy she needs; bar*: each bartender with a Bar adds this to the house proposition rate (barProp), rowdy chance (barRowdy) and client recklessness (barReckless); bath*: massage offers to bathers (bathShare of visitors, bathCap each); tipsBase / danceRep: dancer tips and reputation.
rooms.perRoom: room-service sessions per bedroom per week; Exhibitionist ladies don't use a room.

tidy: starting value, losses (perService room service, perVisitor), maid gain per week = (maidBase + service skill x maidPerSkill) x outfit bonus x her tidy fx, and the three effect tiers (rep per week, mood, energy recovery multiplier) at high (>=75), low (<45) and bad (<20).
rep: positive reputation changes are scaled by max(gainMin, gainBase - rep/gainDiv). Losses are not.

props: propositions. penalty/maxPenalty = main-job output lost per accepted proposition (non-must jobs). accept* = chance a non-must lady accepts (acceptBase + (lust-acceptLustMid)/100 + willing fx, +acceptEager when eager, +acceptReckless when reckless); onChance / offSlip = chance when "Open to propositions" is on / off-but-reckless; alt / altMust = chance of a counter-offer. attendantExpect = share of attendant propositions where the client expected her to offer (expectSat if she declines). self* = reckless ladies propositioning clients. Pushy resolution: security power vs a roll in securityRoll; else Sam (if his energy >= samEnergyMin) checks strength + charm/2 + roll(0..samRoll) >= samCheck; else none. Costs/mood effects follow. When security fails a pushy client and Sam has the energy, he is sent for and the player decides after the report (one event for the week): step in (the old samCheck roll), call the town watch (watchFee per incident, watchRep reputation each), or let her handle it (none penalties).
houseGate: ladies who come with a house (role 'house') can't trust Sam past base + perBeat x (that house's story beat) until the house story is finished. Arc beats for them wait for the story too.
wardrobe: costMult scales every outfit/underwear price (lower = easier to get clothes). eventChance = relative weight of each of the 'someone gave her an outfit' random events (data/events.json).

svc.askMore: after a service that builds her lust (giving, kissing, massages), a lady with lust >= lust.eager and lewdness >= lewd may ask the client for more (chance), offering a heavier service from her menu that spends lust; it pays fee x its normal price.

svc.demon: kissFeed = energy a demon draws from a client's kiss; kissSam (+ kissSamDraw when she's eager, costing Sam kissSamCost extra) from Sam's. restDrainChance / restRepDrain: a restless demon on her week off may drain some poor man in town (town reputation loss; a Demon Sigil doesn't help outside). studCost / studGain / studLust: Sam pays for a stud for the night (sheet button, once a week).

again: after a visit or encounter, a lady who is still worked up may want another round (chance by race, other = everyone else except spirits, + her encore fx; beastkin only need to be eager, others nearly restless). samCost = Sam's energy; mood = her mood gain (twice for beastkin). Once a week each. Ladies who come to Sam because they are restless only pick services that spend lust (releaseSamAct).

sam: Sam's house-wide actions. roundsTrust / roundsMood = what Making the rounds gives every lady (trust is 0-100 here, so 0.4 shows as 4); lessonShare = share of a one-on-one training gain that each lady in a lesson gets.
lewd: lewdness gains go through lewdUp(w, n, cap) (character.js): see its _note. Dates add their own caps (dates.json lewdCap, spicy cap).
jobs.bathJoinLewd / bathJoinFee: a bath attendant comfortable with massages and at least this lewd joins bathers in the water (bath massage, x fee), and may ask for more like anyone else.

lewd._note: Lewdness diminishing returns (lewdUp). Each source has a cap: full gain below cap-band, half at the cap, none past cap+band. Services: cap = service th + capOver. softCap: default cap for sources without one; past it only daring dates, traits and stories push her further.

startLewd._note: Generic ladies' starting lewdness: min + span x r^pow (r uniform 0-1). pow > 1 skews low. Race/sub mods still add on top.

trust._note: Trust is 0-100 here (shown to the player x10, out of 1000). minor = the least any time with Sam builds (practice, private time, anything that gave none).

jobPrefs._note: Rolled job likes/dislikes for generic ladies (and named ones without their own list). Each job's odds: base, plus personality (personalities.json jobsUp/jobsDown), plus trait for each matching trait below, plus ownJob for the job she arrives in. maxLikes/maxDislikes cap the lists.
